name: New AMT redesign
note: Measured live on 22 October 2026 with Lighthouse 13.5.0: three mobile and three desktop runs for the home page, the catalogue, and product AMTGC903-AL21. Every run received HTTP 200. https://klopikkon.com/robots.txt returned the GitHub Pages 404 page, so no crawl rules were published at that URL. On every stored run the is-crawlable audit scored 0, titled “Page is blocked from indexing”, which matches the noindex meta. The SEO category score was 0.66 on every run. Product run 3, mobile and desktop, scored accessibility 0.99 because the heading-order audit scored 0 (“Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order”). The other four product runs scored accessibility 1, so the product accessibility median is 1.
searchCompareNote: Desktop screenshots from 22 October 2026 of the query DSPE-PEG2000. The current AMT search page showed the query and then About Us text, with no product hit. The redesign catalogue said “0 products for DSPE-PEG2000.” Cayman’s search said 22 results; the first visible item was DSPE-PEG(2000)-TCO, item 43626, purity ≥95%.

review.searchNote: The catalogue at https://klopikkon.com/amt/redesign/catalogue/ is a GET form, field name q. Its introduction said “1,347 products from the AMT catalogue extract: 36 Lipids, 212 PEG reagents and linkers, 40 Fluorophores and dyes, 1,046 Organoborons, 13 Other. A price that was not printed is a quote.” Each of the five comparison queries returned a live region of “0 products” and the sentence “No products match. Clear a filter, or browse by family below.” The same search box did return hits for other strings in the same session, so the five zeros are empty result sets: ALC-0315 returned 1 product (ALC-0315); PEG2000 returned 2 products, ALC-0159 (PEG2000) and DMG-PEG (PEG2000); the single word pinacol returned 254 products, page 1 of 11, the first titles being boronic acid pinacol esters. DSPE, mPEG, and NHS each returned 0.

queries.observed: “0 products for DSPE-PEG2000.” No product titles. A separate query, DSPE, was also 0. A separate query, PEG2000, returned ALC-0159 (PEG2000) and DMG-PEG (PEG2000), not a DSPE-PEG2000 row.
“0 products for mPEG-NHS.” No product titles. Separate queries mPEG and NHS were also 0.
“0 products for Cy5.” No product titles. The catalogue introduction on the same page says the extract contains 40 fluorophores and dyes.

“0 products for pinacol boronate.” No product titles. A separate query, pinacol, returned 254 products, and a separate query, boronate, returned 3 products titled sodium methoxyphenylboronate or sodium phenylboronate.

review.filters: When a query had hits (ALC-0315), the filter panel listed Family, CAS, Molecular weight, Purity, Pack size, and Price, USD. A search for pinacol also showed a legend “Type (from name)”. The five comparison queries, which returned nothing, still showed CAS, Molecular weight, and Price, USD. A line under Filters read “Read from the printed product name. Not an AMT heading.” The catalogue with an empty query said “1,347 products. Search, or browse by family.” and did not list those facet legends until a query was present.
review.productNote: https://klopikkon.com/amt/redesign/products/amtgc903-al21/ titled “ALC-0315 · AMTGC903-AL21 · Advanced Molecular Technologies”. The h1 was ALC-0315. Catalogue number AMTGC903-AL21. The specifications table said Formula “Not published” and Molecular weight “Not published”. The page displayed “Price: lower” and the sentence “AMT is the cheapest published list. Fluorochem 1 g €912”, plus a link “Price breakdown”. Those competitor figures are the page’s own text.

productFields.cas: 2036272-55-4 in the specifications table, with a Copy button.
productFields.pricing: Packs shown: 500mg $250.00, 1g $430.00, 2g $790.00. The price-per-mg table showed $0.50/mg, $0.43/mg, and $0.395/mg.
productFields.sds: No SDS link or heading in the rendered text. The current AMT site does not publish SDS files, and this page did not add one.
productFields.coa: No COA or certificate of analysis in the rendered text. The current AMT site does not publish COA files, and this page did not add one.
productFields.structure: Image alt “Structure of ALC-0315 published by Advanced Molecular Technologies”, source /amt/redesign/assets/products/AMTGC903-AL21.png.

review.mobile: At a 390 CSS-pixel viewport the DSPE-PEG2000 catalogue search had scrollWidth minus clientWidth of 0, a Menu control, a Filters button, and the same “0 products for DSPE-PEG2000” live region. The homepage at that width had h1 “Welcome to Advanced Molecular Technologies”, document title “Custom Organic Synthesis | Advanced Molecular Technologies”, and overflow 0.
review.quoteCart: Add to quote was clicked on the product page without changing the pack selector. The status text was “Added 500mg of ALC-0315 to the quote list.” The quote page at /amt/redesign/quote/ then listed ALC-0315, AMTGC903-AL21, 500mg, $250.00, quantity 1, and an indicative total ex GST of $250.00. The page said items stay in this browser and that opening the email addresses sales@amtechpl.com. The control “Open email to AMT” is a mailto link. It was not opened. Copy request and Download CSV were not used, and the name, organisation, and notes fields were left empty. No email was sent.
